exposure: Planned mode of delivery: cesarean section or vaginal delivery
cohort: 7,564 women with a singleton fetus in breech presentation at ≥ 37 weeks of gestation from 138 maternity units in France and Belgium (2001-2002)
finding: In women with a fetus in breech presentation at term, the short-term risk of severe maternal morbidity did not differ significantly between planned cesarean and planned vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in severe acute maternal morbidity rates between planned cesarean and planned vaginal delivery in women with term breech pregnancies.
